scope: Instructed synthetic artifact decisions; no real publication, source execution, natural skill routing, screenshot visual inspection or engineering performance qualification.
order: Case order from frozen suite; alternate baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline across cases. Sequential executions.
model: gpt-6.1-sol; configured reasoning medium; service tier default; effective effort not independently echoed
capabilities: read-only, no tools permitted by task; web, apps, plugins, memories, hooks, shell, browser, code mode and multi-agent features disabled per-run; skill discovery disabled with explicit SKILL.md overrides. Prompt inventory retained. Readiness self-report lists orchestration functions despite flags; evaluate observed tool calls, do not claim tool unavailability.
retry: No automatic retry; retain failed/timeout attempt and mark unverified; any follow-up is a separate recorded attempt.
grading: Owning agent reviews exact captured final answers against three frozen criteria per case. Not independent or blind. Record exact evidence excerpts; no keyword-only automatic scoring.
retention: Raw prompts, visible events, answers, invocation options, inventory, readiness and scored run files retained in ignored output/contribution-evidence. No hidden reasoning retained.
